nodes.speaker: Elara
nodes.text: Blessings upon you, travelers. I am Elara, keeper of the healing arts. You look like you could use some tending to.

nodes.speaker: Elara
nodes.text: Let the light mend your wounds... There. Your party has been fully restored. Be safe out there.

nodes.speaker: Elara
nodes.text: The creatures in the cavern are weak to holy magic. If you have a Cleric in your party, their Smite and Holy Light abilities will serve you well. Also, don't forget to Defend when facing powerful enemies - it can mean the difference between life and death.

nodes.speaker: Elara
nodes.text: Thank you again for finding my amulet. You have my eternal gratitude, and the blessings of the light.

nodes.speaker: Elara
nodes.text: You found it! My grandmother's amulet! Oh, thank you so much! Please, take this reward - you deserve it!

nodes.speaker: Elara
nodes.text: Any luck finding my amulet? I believe I lost it somewhere in the Dark Cavern, near the bottom passages. Please look carefully - it has my initials on it.

nodes.speaker: Elara
nodes.text: Thank you again for finding my amulet. You truly are a blessing to this village.

nodes.speaker: Elara
nodes.text: You found it! My grandmother's amulet! Oh, thank you so much! Please, take this reward - you deserve it!

nodes.speaker: Elara
nodes.text: My amulet... I'm almost certain I dropped it in the deeper parts of the Dark Cavern. Try searching along the walls - there are hidden crevices where it might have fallen. It has a silver chain with my initials engraved on the back.

nodes.speaker: Elara
nodes.text: Actually... yes. I lost my grandmother's silver amulet in the Dark Cavern. I was exploring when creatures attacked and I had to flee. It means the world to me. Could you look for it?

nodes.speaker: Elara
nodes.text: Bless you! I think I dropped it somewhere deeper in the cavern. Search carefully along the walls - there are many hidden crevices down there. I'll reward you handsomely!

nodes.speaker: Elara
nodes.text: May the light guide your path.
